notes.title: Myst 25th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Update v2.2 rev 10535 on Sept 19, 2018:

Here is a quick overview of the changes in this update:

Over 400 fixes and improvements in this update!
Most are art related: textures, materials, meshes, animations, lighting and shaders.
A few small gameplay bugs fixed.

The 'previous-version' beta branch has been updated to the v2.1 update from April, 2018

Enjoy!

notes.title: realMyst: Masterpiece Edition update coming soon...
notes.notes:
Thank you for all your input both on the Steam forums and through the Cyan support site. The information that you provided has been very helpful to the dev team!

We are working on the most critical bugs first to get an update out as quickly as possible. And then we will continue working on all the issues raised and make more fixes and improvements.

Thanks for your patience and for your support!

The Cyan Team
